entries.title: Philippine VP Sara Duterte impeached for a second time
entries.snippet: If convicted in a Senate trial, which is uncertain, she will be disqualified from running for president.

entries.title: French national shows symptoms on return from hantavirus-hit ship

entries.snippet: A dissident in Tehran says she feels helpless and under immense psychological pressure.

entries.title: Oil prices jump after Trump dismisses Iran proposal to end war
entries.snippet: The Strait of Hormuz waterway remains effectively shut, severely disrupting global energy shipments.

entries.snippet: Thaksin seems incapable of taking a back seat. This time, it really could be different.

entries.title: Modi urges Indians to work from home and limit foreign travel as Iran war continues
entries.snippet: He said the austerity measures would reduce India's fuel use and help save foreign exchange.

entries.title: Dua Lipa sues Samsung for $15m over use of her image on TV boxes
entries.snippet: The pop star's legal team alleges a photograph of her face was used on Samsung television boxes without permission.

entries.title: Australia's right-wing One Nation party scores historic parliamentary win
entries.snippet: One Nation gains its first seat in the lower house, in a by-election seen as a key test for the populist party.

entries.title: Dress made from 500 loaves stuns African film awards
entries.snippet: Celebrities, filmmakers and creators put up a performance at Africa's biggest night of film and fashion.

entries.snippet: The Russian leader sees potential for Ukraine negotiations, but condemns the West's backing for President Zelensky.

entries.snippet: Officials are investigating what caused the incident at a popular marina in southern Florida.

entries.title: Army parachutes onto remote island to help Briton with suspected hantavirus
entries.snippet: The specialist team parachuted onto Tristan da Cunha, a remote British overseas territory, to treat them.

entries.snippet: Israel and Hezbollah have continued to trade fire despite a ceasefire deal being announced last month.

entries.title: Buddhist monk arrested over alleged rape of teen in Sri Lanka
entries.snippet: The Venerable Pallegama Hemarathana Thero holds one of the most revered positions in the Buddhist world.

entries.title: Trump rejects Iran's ceasefire proposal response. And, Congress to tackle ICE funding
entries.snippet: Trump rejected Iran's response to a U.S. peace proposal, calling it "totally unacceptable." And, Congressional Republicans are trying to push for three years of funding for immigration enforcement.

entries.title: Oregon's most unexpected gubernatorial candidate? A pencil with a point
entries.snippet: Oregon's public schools rank last in fourth-grade reading, according to an analysis of national testing. As a wake-up call for elected leaders, Pencil is running for governor as a write-in candidate.

entries.title: As ranks of uninsured grow, charity care can be hard to come by at many hospitals
entries.snippet: An investigation of hospital data and charity care programs shows most Minnesota hospitals provide little financial aid to patients and often make assistance difficult to get.

entries.title: Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi transferred to a Tehran hospital, her foundation says
entries.snippet: Nobel Peace laureate and activist Narges Mohammadi has been transferred to a Tehran hospital more than a week after collapsing in prison, her foundation said Sunday.

entries.title: How do you cut your food bill? NPR wants to hear your tips
entries.snippet: With rising food costs, NPR wants to hear your tips and hacks for reducing your bill.

entries.title: It's not shameful, it's savvy: The shoppers redefining how to save money on groceries
entries.snippet: Many facing economic pressures and frustrations have begun shopping at budget grocery stores and warehouse clubs in lieu of traditional supermarkets, with priorities shifting in pursuit of good deals.

entries.title: Marketers say NAD+ pills and infusions can boost longevity. What's the evidence?
entries.snippet: Wellness and longevity influencers are pushing a compound called NAD+. There's scientific interest in its potential, but researchers say the marketing claims have gotten ahead of the science.

entries.title: Morning news brief

entries.title: Remains of US soldier who went missing in Morocco have been recovered
entries.snippet: The remains of a U.S. soldier who went missing during military drills in Morocco were recovered in the Atlantic Ocean, the army said. Military teams are searching for a second missing soldier.

entries.title: U.S. cruise passengers arrive in the U.S. after one tests positive for hantavirus
entries.snippet: One of the 17 Americans tested "mildly" positive for the virus during the U.S. return flight. A French woman has also tested positive — she was was among five French passengers repatriated to Paris.

entries.title: Remains recovered of U.S. soldier who went missing during military exercises in Morocco
entries.snippet: The remains of a U.S. soldier who went missing during military exercises in Morocco a week ago were recovered in the Atlantic Ocean, the army said Sunday.

entries.title: Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi moved to Tehran hospital, her foundation says
entries.snippet: Nobel Peace laureate and activist Narges Mohammadi has been transferred to a Tehran hospital more than a week after collapsing in prison, her foundation said Sunday.

entries.title: Washington Wizards win NBA draft lottery, earn No. 1 pick on June 23
entries.snippet: The Washington Wizards won the draft lottery Sunday, earning the No. 1 pick in next month's draft.

entries.title: Two activists detained over leading an aid flotilla to Gaza are deported by Israel
entries.snippet: Israel deported two activists on Sunday after being detained for slightly over a week for leading an aid flotilla attempting to break the Israeli naval blockade of the Gaza Strip.

entries.title: Indonesian police arrest 321 foreigners in online gambling crackdown
entries.snippet: More than 300 foreign nationals were arrested in a raid on an alleged online gambling operation in the Indonesian capital of Jakarta, police said Saturday.

entries.title: Russia and Ukraine accuse each other of violating U.S.-brokered three-day ceasefire
entries.snippet: Russia and Ukraine swapped accusations of breaking a U.S.-brokered ceasefire on Sunday, with both sides claiming to have suffered casualties in drone and artillery strikes over the past 24 hours.

entries.title: Passengers evacuate MV Hondius cruise ship following hantavirus outbreak
entries.snippet: Passengers evacuated from the hantavirus-hit cruise ship began flying home Sunday aboard military and government planes after the vessel anchored in the Canary Islands.

entries.title: Trump calls Iran's response to ceasefire proposal 'unacceptable'
entries.snippet: Iran sent its response to the latest U.S. proposal to end the Iran war via Pakistani mediators on Sunday, but U.S. President Donald Trump quickly rejected it in a social media post as "TOTALLY UNACCEPTABLE!"

entries.title: Death toll rises to 14 in Pakistan suicide attack as Pakistani Taliban breakaway group claims responsibility
entries.snippet: A suicide bomber and several gunmen detonated an explosives-laden vehicle near the post in Bannu, a district in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province bordering Afghanistan, late Saturday, said senior police official Sajjad Khan.

entries.title: Moscow holds scaled-back Victory Day Parade under heavy security
entries.snippet: Russian President Vladimir Putin on Saturday voiced confidence in a victory in Ukraine as he oversaw a military parade on Red Square commemorating the defeat of Nazi Germany in World War II.

entries.title: Surfers in war-torn Gaza find rare moments of joy in the waves
entries.snippet: Despite the dire humanitarian crisis across the Gaza Strip, where a fragile ceasefire remains in place, a handful of Palestinian surfers are finding joy — and relief — riding the waves of the territory's Mediterranean coastal waters.

entries.title: Fragile Iran ceasefire appears to hold as Iran warns the U.S. against attacks on its oil tankers and other ships
entries.snippet: Iran's Revolutionary Guard navy on Saturday warned that any attack on Iranian oil tankers or commercial vessels would be met with a "heavy assault" on one of the U.S. bases in the region and enemy ships, even as a tenuous ceasefire appeared to be holding.

entries.title: Medical epidemiologist explains what to know about the cruise ship hantavirus outbreak
entries.snippet: A medical epidemiologist explains what you need to know about the hantavirus virus and how the outbreak is playing out.

entries.title: Bobby Cox, longtime Braves manager and Hall of Famer, dies at 84
entries.snippet: Bobby Cox, the folksy manager of the Atlanta Braves whose teams ruled the National League during the 1990s and gave the city its first major title as well as World Series trips that fell short, died Saturday. He was 84.

entries.title: Israeli drone strikes kill 4 near Beirut as southern airstrikes kill at least 13
entries.snippet: The three drone strikes south of Beirut marked another escalation since a ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah went into effect on April 17.

entries.title: Rescuers find 1 body after volcano eruption in Indonesia as search continues for 2 more
entries.snippet: Rescuers on Saturday recovered the body of an Indonesian woman who was caught in a volcanic eruption at Mount Dukono a day earlier, as search operations continued to find the bodies of two Singaporeans, officials said.

entries.title: Pedestrian killed after being struck by Frontier Airlines plane taking off in Denver
entries.snippet: A person who jumped a fence and was on a runway at Denver International Airport was struck and killed by a Frontier Airlines plane during takeoff, airport authorities said.

entries.title: The latest congressional redistricting changes and what to know
entries.snippet: The remaking of the U.S. political map accelerated this week in courts and legislatures. Here's a look at where things stand.

entries.title: U.S. strikes on Iranian tankers raise more questions over negotiations to end war

entries.title: What a stronger than expected jobs report tells us about the state of the economy
entries.snippet: The Labor Department reported Friday that unemployment held steady in April and that the U.S. added 115,000 jobs, surpassing expectations. For more on the numbers and what they tell us about the state of the economy, Amna Nawaz speaks with Mohamed El-Erian, a professor at the Wha

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: What will happen to Iran's nuclear material?
entries.snippet: Iran is believed to have over 440 kilos (970 pounds) of enriched uranium, which could be turned into weapons-grade nuclear material. Despite Trump's pledge to get the "nuclear dust," Tehran has kept it out of US reach.

entries.title: Philippine lawmakers move to impeach VP Sara Duterte
entries.snippet: Lawmakers in the Philippines have voted for proceedings to impeach Vice President Sara Duterte. A Senate trial could remove her from office and block any 2028 presidential run.

entries.title: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer 'not walking away' after local election mauling
entries.snippet: Keir Starmer has said he takes "responsibility" for Labour's poor election performance, but also for putting matters right again. "I know I have my doubters and I know I need to prove them wrong, and I will," he said.

entries.title: Endemic, epidemic, pandemic: What's the difference?
entries.snippet: The Andes hantavirus outbreak shows how easily disease labels are misunderstood — and why they describe patterns of spread, not how dangerous a virus is.

entries.title: Hantavirus: Evacuated passengers begin returning home
entries.snippet: Passengers on the ill-fated cruise from several European countries, including Germany, are returning home and will be screened by health authorities. One French woman developed symptoms on the return flight. Follow DW.

entries.title: Nazi-looted artwork surfaces with Dutch collaborator's heirs
entries.snippet: A Nazi-looted painting from a famed Dutch collection has surfaced in the home of decendents of a senior Nazi collaborator. The painting’s wherabouts became known after a relative discovered the truth.

entries.title: Somali piracy adds new strain to global shipping and trade routes
entries.snippet: As ships reroute around Africa to avoid Middle East conflict zones, piracy off Somalia is back. The resurgence is driving up insurance, transit times and security costs, putting new pressure on global supply chains.

entries.title: India news: Cut fuel use, gold buys and foreign trips, says Modi, as no end in sight to Iran war
entries.snippet: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is asking Indians to work from home more and make a series of changes in their consumption habits, including cutting down on foreign trips and buying gold jewelry.

entries.title: Germany's businesses frustrated by economic decline
entries.snippet: No one had higher hopes for Friedrich Merz's chancellorship than the German business community. Now, however, early euphoria has given way to bitter disappointment.

entries.title: Why is Hollywood missing from Cannes?
entries.snippet: There are no US blockbusters premiering at the Cannes Film Festival this year. So who's snubbing who?

entries.title: Germany news: Defense minister Pistorius arrives in Kyiv
entries.snippet: Pistorius plans to discuss building a new weapons system with Ukraine in the unannounced visit. Meanwhile in Stuttgart, five pro-Palestinian activists face trial over attacking an Israeli defense company site. Follow DW.

entries.title: Former Thai Prime Minister Thaksin let out of prison early
entries.snippet: Thailand's influential former prime minister Thaksin Shinawatra will be required to wear an electronic monitor during his four-month probation period.

entries.title: Iranian Nobel winner Mohammadi moved to Tehran hospital
entries.snippet: Human rights activist and Nobel Peace Prize laureate Narges Mohammadi has been released on bail and transferred to Tehran, her foundation said, amid alarm about her health.

entries.title: Iran war: Trump rejects proposal to end conflict
entries.snippet: Donald Trump has called Iran's plan "totally unacceptable." The fragile ceasefire had been tested earlier in the day by Iranian strikes across the Gulf. DW has more.

entries.title: Syria: Court charges Bashar Assad's cousin Atef Najib with war crimes amid 2011 uprising
entries.snippet: Syria's judiciary has charged Atef Najib with acts "amounting to war crimes" as Bashar Assad's cousin is accused of orchestrating a crackdown on 2011 protests that subsequently degenerated into a decade of civil war.

entries.title: Could German ex-leader really negotiate Ukraine peace?
entries.snippet: Former German chancellor Gerhard Schröder is a controversial — and some critics would even say, unserious — choice as a negotiator on the Ukraine war. He's long been criticized for being too close to Russia.

entries.title: Germany: 'Ulm 5' on trial after attack on Israeli arms firm
entries.snippet: Five activists have gone on trial in Germany following a break-in at the Israeli arms company Elbit Systems in Ulm. Their lawyers intend to argue they were trying to obstruct a genocide.

entries.title: RSF urges Niger to ditch 'abusive' French media ban
entries.snippet: Media watchdog Reporters Without Borders has called on Niger's Russian-backed military government to lift its sudden suspension of nine French media outlets. This coincides with major instability in neighboring Mali.

entries.title: France turns to Africa for strategic partnerships
entries.snippet: Following a withdrawal from the Sahel region, France is seeking to expand its geostrategic influence in Africa by seeking new allies. The first Africa Summit in Kenya is intended to mark a fresh start.
